description: Known answers for the OpenSCAD 2021.01 + FreeCAD 1.1.3 sanity check (tools/toolchain.lock.md section 1.1; CM plan section 9.2 table; TV due PDR, shared). cube.scad is a 30 x 20 x 10 mm block minus a 6 mm diameter through hole ($fn = 64) on the vertical axis at (15, 10). Expected values were derived by hand from that geometry before the first run: analytic volume 30 x 20 x 10 - pi x 3^2 x 10 = 5717.257 mm^3 (a 64-sided prism would give 5717.711 mm^3; the two differ by 0.008 %, so the face types, not the volume, show whether FreeCAD made a true cylinder). The STEP step uses the listing of docs/research/enclosure-cnc-and-openscad-pipeline.md step 3 until tools/scad2step.py is committed (CM plan section 8.2 step 3; ADR-008); a run with the listing is developer evidence for freecadcmd, not the known-answer test of tools/scad2step.py.

must_contain: cylinder($fn = 64, $fa = 12, $fs = 2, h = 12, r1 = 3, r2 = 3, center = false);

png_render.inspection: the render is opened and inspected: a rectangular block with one round through hole

step_rejected_by_openscad.expected: non-zero exit and no cube.step written (OpenSCAD 2021.01 cannot export STEP; CM plan section 8.2 step 3)

step_export.measurement: solid count, validity, face types and volume printed by freecadcmd from the exported shape; bounding box measured independently of FreeCAD from the CARTESIAN_POINT entities referenced by VERTEX_POINT entities of cube.step
